mapper.select:
SELECT T.CONSTRUCTION_COLUMN COLUMN_NAME, T.REGULAR_EXPRESSION, T.ERROR_TIPS FROM T_PLM_BOM_CONSTRUCTION_MAPPING T WHERE IS_DELETE = '0' AND CONSTRUCTION_COLUMN NOT IN (
'EMBRYO_CODE', 'EMBRYO_VERSION',
'CLAMPING_PRESSURE', 'CURING_TIME' )

WITH TEMP_TAB AS
(SELECT CONNECT_BY_ROOT REGEXP_SUBSTR(T.CHILD_CODE, '\w+') EMBRYO_CODE, CONNECT_BY_ROOT CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION EMBRYO_VERSION, CONNECT_BY_ROOT T.SAP_VERSION SAP_VERSION,
SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(NVL(STATUS, 1), '/') STATUS_PATH,
CASE WHEN CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SUBSTR(REPLACE(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE, '/'), '/' || CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE), INSTR(REPLACE(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE, '/'), '/' || CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE), '/', -1) + 1) END PARENT_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE,
SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(id, '/') ID_PATH, CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE, CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE, CHILD_CODE, BOM_VERSION, PARENT_MATERIAL_CODE, PARENT_CODE,
NVL(T.MES_UPDATE_DATE, T.MES_CREATE_DATE) UPDATE_DATE, NVL(T.MES_CREATE_DATE, T.MES_UPDATE_DATE) CREATE_DATE, T.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION, NVL(STATUS, 1) STATUS, T.DOSAGE, T.ID FROM T_BOM_INFO T
WHERE NVL(STATUS, 1) != '3'
START WITH T.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'EMBRYO' AND T.CHILD_CODE LIKE #{embryoCode} || '%' AND T.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION = #{embryoVersion}
AND NVL(STATUS, 1) != '3'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_BOM_INFO TT WHERE T.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE = TT.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE AND TT.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'EMBRYO' AND T.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION = TT.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION AND (TT.MES_UPDATE_DATE > T.MES_UPDATE_DATE OR TT.MES_UPDATE_DATE = T.MES_UPDATE_DATE AND TT.MES_CREATE_DATE > T.MES_CREATE_DATE OR TT.MES_UPDATE_DATE = T.MES_UPDATE_DATE AND TT.MES_CREATE_DATE = T.MES_CREATE_DATE AND TT.ID > T.ID)
AND NVL(TT.STATUS, 1) != '3')
CONNECT BY PRIOR T.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE = T.PARENT_MATERIAL_CODE AND (PRIOR T.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION = T.BOM_VERSION AND PRIOR T.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'EMBRYO' OR PRIOR T.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE != 'EMBRYO' ) )
SELECT T1.EMBRYO_CODE, T1.EMBRYO_VERSION, T1.SAP_VERSION, M.CONSTRUCTION_COLUMN COLUMN_NAME,
CASE WHEN T1.STATUS_PATH like '%3%' THEN null ELSE
DECODE(M.SOURCE_COLUMN, 1, T1.CHILD_CODE, 2, T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE, 3, T1.PARENT_CODE, 4, DECODE(P.IS_DELETE, 0, P.PARAM_VALUE, null), 5, to_char(T1.DOSAGE), 6, T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION, NULL)
END
COLUMN_VALUE, T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE, T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE, T1.PARENT_MATERIAL_CODE,
ID_PATH ID, M.SORT_CODE, T1.UPDATE_DATE, T1.CREATE_DATE,
NVL(p.UPDATE_DATE, NVL(p.CREATE_DATE, T1.UPDATE_DATE)) PLM_UPDATE_DATE, nvl(T1.DOSAGE, 0) DOSAGE, M.REMARK, M.MATERIAL_TYPE FROM TEMP_TAB T1 INNER JOIN T_PLM_BOM_CONSTRUCTION_MAPPING M ON T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE || ':' || T1.PARENT_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = M.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE || ':' || M.PARENT_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE AND M.CONSTRUCTION_COLUMN NOT IN (
'EMBRYO_CODE', 'EMBRYO_VERSION',
'CLAMPING_PRESSURE', 'CURING_TIME' ) AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 AND M.Material_Type = #{materialType} LEFT JOIN T_PLM_CONSTRUCTION_INFO P ON P.SAP_CODE = T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_CODE AND P.PARAM_CODE = M.PARAM_CODE AND M.SOURCE_COLUMN = 4
AND (T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'EMBRYO' AND T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_VERSION = P.VERSION OR T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE != 'EMBRYO') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 0 FROM T_PLM_CONSTRUCTION_INFO PP WHERE PP.SAP_CODE = P.SAP_CODE AND PP.PARAM_CODE = P.PARAM_CODE AND (T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE = 'EMBRYO' AND PP.VERSION = P.VERSION OR T1.CHILD_MATERIAL_NAME_CODE != 'EMBRYO') AND (NVL(PP.UPDATE_DATE, PP.CREATE_DATE) > NVL(P.UPDATE_DATE, P.CREATE_DATE) OR NVL(PP.UPDATE_DATE, PP.CREATE_DATE) = NVL(P.UPDATE_DATE, P.CREATE_DATE) AND PP.ID > P.ID))
